name: Aaron Saidman
bio: Aaron Saidman is an American nonfiction creator and executive producer known for series such as Leah Remini: Scientology and the Aftermath, Night Stalker: The Hunt for a Serial Killer, Free Meek, Living Undocumented, Indian Matchmaking, and This Is Paris. He is the co-founder and President of The Intellectual Property Corporation. Saidman has received major industry honors, including a Primetime Emmy and a TCA Award, and continues to produce acclaimed documentary and unscripted projects for platforms like Netflix, HBO, Hulu, and A&E.
